name: LXRXXL
author: L'Cronx
summary: A port of the open-source Sonic Potions LXR engine to MPC, with LXR-02-style features written from the manual. The whole panel on one page, 64-step sequencer with songs, rolls and a euclidean generator, Force pads playing the voices, randomizers and the Hrtl LXR-02 DLC presets. Artwork by Suns Kiefer.
